gw_live.clock_unsynced: The server clock is not synchronised: quotas are not counted for now. Turn on a time service: timedatectl set-ntp true (chrony or systemd-timesyncd)
gw_live.event.exit_alive_n: Exit “{name}” is working again (drops in 15 min: {n})
gw_live.event.exit_country_changed: Exit “{name}”: the country changed — was {old}, now {new}; traffic goes on as before
gw_live.event.exit_country_changed_all: Exit “{name}”: country {old} → {new}, but it changed for all exits at once — likely a country lookup failure
gw_live.event.exit_failover_back: Devices are back on the primary level “{to}” ({devices})
gw_live.event.exit_quota: Exit “{name}”: {pct}% of the quota used — {used} of {limit} GB{reset}
gw_live.event.exit_quota_full: Exit “{name}”: the quota is used up — {used} of {limit} GB{reset}
gw_live.event.exit_recovered_after: Exit “{name}” is back in use (was {was} for {after})
gw_live.event.exit_removed_country: Exit “{name}” is taken out: wrong exit country
gw_live.event.exit_removed_maintenance: Exit “{name}” is taken out for maintenance
gw_live.event.exit_removed_quota: Exit “{name}” is taken out: the traffic quota is used up
gw_live.event.exit_removed_rule: Exit “{name}” is taken out by condition “{rule}”
gw_live.event.exit_rule_push: Exit “{name}”: condition “{rule}” fired — {what}; the exit stays in use
gw_live.event.exit_standby_manual: Exit “{name}” was put on standby by hand
gw_live.event.exit_standby_rule: Exit “{name}” is on standby by condition “{rule}”
gw_live.event.exit_standby_sub_confirm: Subscription “{sub}”: new key “{name}” was put on standby — confirm it in Exits
gw_live.event.exit_standby_sub_confirm_g: Subscription “{sub}”: new key “{name}” was put on standby in group “{group}” — confirm it in Exits
gw_live.event.exit_standby_unstable: Exit “{name}” on standby: unstable ({flaps} in 15 min), back at {until}
gw_live.event.exit_standby_unstable_now: Exit “{name}” on standby: unstable ({flaps} in 15 min)
gw_live.event.group_last_step_ru: “{name}”: no exit works — Russian sites are closed {devices}
gw_live.event.group_last_step_ru_direct: “{name}”: no exit works — Russian sites {devices} open directly from the server’s address; banks may ask to confirm the sign-in
gw_live.event.group_regrouped_none: “{name}”: regrouped — every device is already on its own exit
gw_live.event.group_regrouped_frozen: “{name}”: could not regroup — the server is offline, the layout is frozen
gw_live.event.group_regrouped_frozen_ru: “{name}”: could not regroup — the server cannot reach Russian addresses, the layout is frozen
gw_live.event.node_offline: The server has been offline since {since}
gw_live.event.node_offline_held: The server went offline at {since}; no message came that it is back online
gw_live.event.node_offline_held_now: The server went offline; no message came that it is back online
gw_live.event.node_online: The server was offline from {since} to {until} ({minutes})
gw_live.event.node_online_restart: The server was offline from {since} to {until} ({minutes}); checked after a restart of the Kaskad collector, it may have come back later
gw_live.event.routing_restored: Gateway routing (ip rules, tables 199 and 200, kgw0) restored
gw_live.event.ru_guard_nft: Protection tripped: Russia direct without the ⚠RU confirmation would have gone into the nft table ({n}). The addresses are not added. This is a Kaskad fault — please tell the developers
gw_live.event.ru_guard_xray: Protection tripped: the new xray config had Russia direct without the ⚠RU confirmation ({n}). The config is not applied, Russia is closed. This is a Kaskad fault — please tell the developers
gw_live.event.speedtest_budget_day: Exit “{name}”: the speed test limit for today is used up
gw_live.event.speedtest_budget_month: Exit “{name}”: the speed test limit for this month is used up
gw_live.event.table_restored: The gateway part of the nftables table was missing — restored
gw_live.event.unstable: Exit “{name}” is unstable: {flaps} in 15 min, now {state}
gw_live.event.xray_rejected: xray rejected the new exit settings: {error} — the previous ones keep working
gw_live.event.xray_rejected_stopped: xray rejected the new exit settings: {error} — the gateway xray is stopped to close Russia direct without the choice or the ⚠RU confirmation
gw_live.event.xray_ru_closed: Russia direct without the choice or the ⚠RU confirmation is closed: the gateway xray restarted with the current settings or is stopped
gw_live.event.xray_ru_closed_allowed: Russia direct is allowed again: the “Russia direct” choice or the ⚠RU confirmation is back. The gateway xray keeps running, no restart
gw_live.event.xray_ru_closed_stopped: The gateway xray is stopped to close Russia direct without the choice or the ⚠RU confirmation: SOCKS5 and VLESS don’t work until xray takes a new config. The reason is in the feed next to this
gw_live.event.xray_ru_open: Couldn’t stop the gateway xray: Russia may still go directly for users without the “Russia direct” choice or the ⚠RU confirmation. Stop the xray process by hand or reboot the server, then run kaskadctl gw apply
gw_live.log.feed_bad: GW live: {path} is broken — moved aside to {aside}, the feed of the exits starts anew
gw_live.metric.other: a reading of {value} crossed the limit of {threshold}
gw_live.n.devices_direct: {n} device goes out directly from the server’s address|{n} devices go out directly from the server’s address
gw_live.n.devices_of: {n} device cannot reach the internet|{n} devices cannot reach the internet
gw_live.no_pool: No exit in the pool is working: clients routed through exits are blocked
gw_live.no_pool_direct: No exit in the pool is working: clients routed through exits go out directly from the server’s address
gw_live.no_pool_mixed: No exit in the pool is working: some clients routed through exits go out directly from the server’s address, the rest are blocked
gw_live.result.exec_condition: did not start: its start condition was not met
gw_live.result.resources: did not start: not enough resources
gw_live.result.start_limit_hit: restarted too often — systemd no longer starts it
gw_live.result.watchdog: did not answer the systemd watchdog
gw_live.why.not_found: service {unit} is missing on the server — reinstall the protocol
gw_live.xray_down: Gateway xray ({unit}) is down: SOCKS5, the VLESS protocol and VLESS exits are unavailable
gw_live.event.bench_done: Server check ({mode_text}) is done: {rel} of usual
gw_live.event.bench_partial: Server check ({mode_text}) is done, not every test passed
gw_live.event.bench_worse: The server is notably worse than usual: «{link}» {now}, usually {usual}
gw_live.event.bench_worse_bare: The server is notably worse than usual: «{link}»
gw_live.event.exit_country_changed_ru: Domestic exit “{name}” (group “{group}”): the country changed — was {old}, now {new}; traffic goes on as before
gw_live.event.node_ru_offline: The server cannot reach Russian addresses since {since}; the domestic exits stay as they are until it can
gw_live.event.node_ru_offline_now: The server cannot reach Russian addresses; the domestic exits stay as they are until it can
gw_live.event.node_ru_online: The server could not reach Russian addresses from {since} to {until} ({minutes})
gw_live.event.node_ru_online_restart: The server could not reach Russian addresses from {since} to {until} ({minutes}); checked after a restart of the Kaskad collector, they may have come back earlier
gw_live.event.node_ru_online_back: The server reaches Russian addresses again
gw_live.event.group_regrouped_late: “{name}”: could not regroup — the request waited over 5 min while the collector was not running. Press it again
gw_live.event.ip6_prefix_changed: The IPv6 prefix changed: {old} → {new} (interface {iface}). The new address is {suggest}; if the old one was in the IPv6 “Accept” list, move the role to the new one: it never moves by itself.
